experiences.name: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day
experiences.description: Spend a full day at the iconic Magic Kingdom, home to Cinderella Castle, Space Mountain, and the Festival of Fantasy parade. Arrive early to beat crowds and stay for the spectacular nighttime fireworks show 'Disney Enchantment'. Ideal for families with children of all ages. Book FastPass+ selections in advance to maximize ride time and minimize wait times. With a late Day 1 arrival, plan this for Day 2 as your first major park experience after a rested morning.
experiences.location: Magic Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour
experiences.description: Explore EPCOT's World Showcase, a living cultural festival featuring 11 country pavilions including France, Japan, Morocco, and Mexico. Sample authentic international cuisines, watch cultural performances, and browse artisan crafts. This experience combines food, entertainment, and culture in one park. Best enjoyed mid-week when crowds are lighter. A perfect Day 3 activity after settling in near the resort area, with dining reservations recommended at signature restaurants like Le Cellier or Teppan Edo.
experiences.location: EPCOT, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Hollywood Studios & Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure
experiences.description: Immerse your family in the cinematic world of Disney's Hollywood Studios, highlighted by the fully realized Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge land. Pilot the Millennium Falcon on Smugglers Run, battle the First Order on Rise of the Resistance, and build your own lightsaber at Savi's Workshop. Also enjoy Toy Story Land and the thrilling Tower of Terror. Staying at a Disney on-site hotel near Hollywood Studios grants early park entry, making this a must for families with Star Wars fans.
experiences.location: Hollywood Studios, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening
experiences.description: Spend a relaxed evening at Disney Springs, Disney World's free-admission entertainment, dining, and shopping district. Enjoy world-class dining at The BOATHOUSE or Morimoto Asia, catch a live street performance, visit the LEGO Store, or watch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24. This is an ideal activity for Day 1 arrival evening since it requires no park ticket and is easily accessible from nearby hotels. A great way to ease into the Disney experience without overwhelming the family after a long travel day.
experiences.location: Disney Springs, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage
experiences.description: Discover Disney's Animal Kingdom, a unique blend of wildlife conservation and thrilling attractions. Start with the Kilimanjaro Safaris at dawn to see lions, elephants, and giraffes in their most active state. Then head to Pandora – The World of Avatar for the breathtaking Flight of Passage ride, one of Disney's most acclaimed experiences. End the day with a live performance of the Festival of the Lion King. Staying at a nearby Disney resort hotel allows early park entry, giving your family a head start on the most popular rides before crowds build.
experiences.location: Animal Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista
